note: Southeast Fairbanks Census Area is an unorganized borough with no county zoning. Its only zoning-bearing city, Delta Junction, publishes zoning only as text in Title 4 Land Use PDF code; its city map is a PDF street map with city limits, not zoning. ArcGIS search for zoning in the area found only Fairbanks North Star Borough and Whittier layers, neither in this county. No queryable zoning district polygon service exists for the county or its cities.
